desc: Phoenix egg spirit: egg-shaped dark violet body cracked with red crystal glow, tiny feet. Face: a single eye peeking through the crack, orange iris, curious. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
